verdict.rationale: Whether a product's source is available under an open license is a fair question for a developer-tooling SaaS like LightSprint, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack mentions a public repository, an open-source license, or source availability. The option to run LightSprint in your own infrastructure (docs-30) is a deployment choice and does not mean the source is open.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license
